title: The P7 slice of RWB-E1-046, the row that holds the template version, the catalog read paths, the table and columns and the login are not settled by any one source
source: WP B2-P7-013; legacy RWB-E1-046 (sections 1 to 19); FSD P7 Decision center and log v3 A2.10, A2.11, A2.12 and A2.22; TSD P7 Decision center and log v2 T2, T3.1, T3.2 and T5; RWB-P6-E1046-CON and RWB-P6-E1046-APP; Context pack P7 rwb-decision; Template and Rules v1 sections R3, R4, R5.5 (DP-01, DP-07, DP-11, DP-13, DP-15, DP-19), R5.7 and R9
description: One combined gap covers everything this slice cannot read from a single source. (1) The FSD P7 module lists FEAT-DRI-16 with story RWB-E1-046 in its own feature table, while the Ownership Map and the context pack give template and merge_field to P6 rwb-comms and give P7 only approval, decision_log_entry, rule_package, rule_package_version, rule_row and rule_test_case, so no source states what the P7 copy of the legacy key delivers. (2) FSD P7 A2.10 requires the D7.1 decision record to hold template DEMAND-MTG version 2, while TSD P7 T3.1 gives decision_log_entry no template column and no catalog column, so the placement of the values is given nowhere. (3) The plan sets Depends on (build) to None while the DP table adds H RWB-PLT-E1043-CON (DP-07), H RWB-PLT-E1044-CON (DP-15) and H RWB-PLT-N001-CON (DP-19). (4) The catalog read paths, the merge-field read path and the catalog-version read path are absent from the RWB-P6-E1046-CON baseline, which fixes resource and operation names only, and from API Specification v4. (5) No source names the row that would hold the recorded template reference, its columns, its keys or its migration file. (6) The legacy load files name the approver as a staff identifier such as LEG-0001 while TSD P7 T3.1 types every user reference as a uuid. (7) The rwb-decision login name (DP-02) is given nowhere; the legacy story ran on the shared recovery_svc login.
evidence: FSD P7 v3 feature table row (P7, FEAT-DRI-16, Hold the template catalog with merge fields, E1) and A2.12 with AC-P7-012-01, AC-ALT-P7-012-01 and AC-EXC-P7-012-01 to AC-EXC-P7-012-06; FSD P7 v3 AC-P7-010-01 (one decision log entry with decision code D7.1, rule R-LIT-03 and template DEMAND-MTG version 2); FSD P7 v3 AC-EXC-P7-022-02 (a withdrawn template blocks approval with status 409 and MSG-P6-003); TSD P7 v2 T3.1 decision_log_entry DF-DEC-001 to DF-DEC-018, DF-DEC-028 to DF-DEC-031 with no template field; TSD P7 v2 T3.2 (LOV-APPROVAL-LEVEL, LOV-APPROVAL-STATUS, LOV-CAPABILITY, LOV-PRODUCT); Context pack P7 service row (schema rwb_decision, base /api/recovery/decision/v1, topic rwb.decision.events.v1, queue rwb-decision) and its ownership rows (6 tables, no template and no merge_field); RWB-P6-E1046-CON sections 11, 12.1 and 12.7 (the catalogue, its operations and the two tables in rwb_comms); WP B2-P7-013 story line ("H": [], "C": ["RWB-P6-E1046-CON"], patterns DP01, DP07, DP11, DP13, DP15, DP19); Template and Rules v1 section R5.5 rows DP-07, DP-15 and DP-19.
area: Service ownership, the recorded template reference and the consumed catalog contract
proposed: Keep the catalogue single and P6's and make the P7 copy the record side of the same key: one template_use row per accepted answer holding template code, language, version, catalog version in force, merge codes, notice type, product group, approver reference, valid from and business date, with no catalog row copied; publish the current-version, merge-field and catalog-version reads in RWB-P6-E1046-CON at the contract review and fake them until then; treat the three platform H rows as wave-0 prerequisites so lane L-P7-M stays Day 1; fix the table, its columns and the migration file in the rwb_decision DB story; resolve the approver identifier to a user reference at the same review; name the login before the rwb_decision baseline is created.
